MAR MOR - Inpatient Cardiology Progress Note
Salient Cardiac Features


History of congestive heart failure and prior coronary angiography in 2022 without need for stent placement or surgical intervention.


Current admission with elevated troponin, peak reported at 0.601, with ongoing evaluation for possible ischemic contribution.


Volume overload symptoms improved with diuresis.


Hemoptysis is present, requiring close monitoring while receiving anticoagulation therapy.


SOAP Note
Subjective


Patient reports symptoms began Sunday night with inability to sleep and feeling unwell.


Reports decreased appetite and inability to eat normally.


Denies chest pain.


Reports blood in phlegm.


Discussed prior angiogram performed in December 2022, with medical management pursued and no stent or surgery required.


Discussed possibility of repeat angiography depending on clinical course and availability.


Patient and family expressed understanding of the plan.

Extremities: No additional findings documented.

Elevated troponin level (ICD-10: R79.89)


Hemoptysis (ICD-10: R04.2)


Plan


Continue diuresis and monitor urine output closely.


Monitor hemoptysis closely, particularly while receiving heparin therapy.


Avoid escalation of anticoagulation while evaluating bleeding symptoms.


Continue medical management and reassess need for repeat coronary angiography after stabilization.

Monitor clinical response and hemoglobin.

Monitor urine output while receiving diuretic therapy.
